title: Chronic kidney disease: stage, hypertension and dialysis status
question: Assign the ICD-10-CM codes for the patient's kidney disease and any related hypertension and dialysis status.
note:
Chief Complaint
Follow-up for chronic kidney disease.

HPI
The patient is a 62-year-old male presenting for a routine follow-up of his chronic kidney disease. He reports feeling generally well today with no acute complaints of edema, fatigue, or changes in urinary output. He has been compliant with his current medications and has maintained a stable weight over the last three months. He denies any new shortness of breath or significant joint pain. He is here to monitor his renal function and manage his stable condition.

Medication List
Lisinopril 10mg daily, Amlodipine 5mg daily.

Exam
The patient is alert and oriented. Vital signs are stable within normal limits. Chest is clear to auscultation. Heart sounds are regular with no murmurs. No peripheral edema is noted in the lower extremities. Skin is warm and dry.

Assessment
Chronic kidney disease, stage 3. The patient is currently stable and asymptomatic.

Plan
Continue current medication regimen. Order repeat basic metabolic panel and serum creatinine in three months to monitor progress of chronic kidney disease. Patient instructed to call the office if any new symptoms arise.
